profile.name: Sumit Kumar
profile.title: MERN Stack Developer
profile.tagline: I build fast, type-safe React and Next.js applications on top of REST APIs, and ship them to production.
profile.summary: MERN-focused Full Stack Developer with about 2 years of experience at Duskbyte, building and deploying production web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, React.js and Next.js. I design REST APIs and back them with Laravel, PostgreSQL and MySQL, and I have shipped Docker-based deployments, authentication and RBAC, ETL pipelines, and third-party and AI API integrations end to end.

highlights: Build and maintain full-stack applications using Laravel, React.js, Next.js (TypeScript), Vue.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs.
Dockerize legacy applications and deploy them to Linux production servers over SSH, configuring environments and hosting under the Duskbyte domain.
Work on a property-tax compensation platform: ETL automation, large-scale data processing, and migration to FastAPI and React.js.
Mentor 2 trainees on how live projects work and delegate feature work to them on the Workspace platform.
Evaluate third-party tools, libraries, and architectures against project requirements and recommend options.
Worked on a Buyer Commission project (Laravel, React.js) and a Chrome extension, building and integrating REST APIs.
Learned how a production application works end to end, from frontend requests through backend APIs to the database.
Built Fitness Freak, a front-end-only React.js website, using hooks, state management, and reusable UI components.

projects.title: Duskbyte Workspace
projects.summary: The internal workspace and ticketing platform the Duskbyte team uses daily to assign and track work.
highlights: Designed and built the platform end to end: architecture, database, backend APIs, frontend, and production deployment.
Replaced scattered task tracking across chats with centralized ticketing, assignment and status tracking.
Added ticket status views so team progress is visible at a glance without follow-up messages.

projects.title: Free Tax Protest
projects.summary: A client property-tax compensation platform serving Denton and Tarrant county workflows, with a large-scale ETL pipeline and a migration to FastAPI and React underway.
highlights: 2026 (ongoing): Automating ETL for 20 raw files (50+ GB, 8.4M+ records, 500+ columns), converting to Parquet/JSONL with DuckDB and loading type-cast data into PostgreSQL. A run now completes in about 6 minutes, with further optimization in progress.

2026 (ongoing): Migrating the app to FastAPI (Python) and React.js (TypeScript), learning Python and FastAPI along the way: schema design, custom cookie-based authentication, RBAC, and admin/user features.
2025: Dockerized the app and migrated the Laravel Blade/Vue.js admin panel to a Laravel REST API with a React.js (TypeScript) frontend.
2025: Moved file storage to Amazon S3, integrated SendGrid SMTP, tested email flows with Mailtrap, and migrated 70+ email templates to dynamic templates.
2025: Adapted the architecture for Denton and Tarrant county workflows and implemented OAuth SSO (Laravel Passport) for user/admin switching.
